reviews.t: Great concept if it worked properly 😩
reviews.x: [[VIDEOID:f6f0160be33bf9c0ae30e89cb3c07bfe]] The part that attaches to the wand which allows the brush to spin keeps falling off...the product should clean brushes great so it does the job, I just have to continue reinerting the part back into the wand to complete the cleaning process!

Just got this today and immediately tried it on my 20+ makeup brushes. Well this little machine did not disappoint! I loved it! Cleaned all my brushes in a variety of sizes in no time. Best part of it was I didn’t have to wait 24hrs for the brushes to dry!

reviews.t: Dry, Clean, Brushes in an Instant!
reviews.x: Pros, clean and then instantly dry brushes. No more waiting for dayyyysss for them to dry! I was blown away. Cons, some of my brushes aren't a perfect fit and would fall out of the silicone sleeves. I do have some odd ones though, but if you use standards you're probably fine. I also dont like that I cant do my dual ended eye brushes like from my UD NAKED palettes. But for the instantly dry factor, this is soooo worth it!

Really love my brush cleaner! Arrived today and tried it immediately and was not disappointed. The only thing is I hope that they can develop some sort of silicon brush holder that would fit universally regardless what shape the brush is. Also, the heavier your brush is the slower the machine rotates the brush, thus maybe less cleaner than smaller brushes. Anyway, 10/10.
Cleans makeup brushes well. Fast shipping.

reviews.t: Effective cleaning device, easy to use
reviews.x: I received this item today and used successfully without issue to cleanse all of my makeup brush collection is less than 20 minutes! They really do dry quite fast- it made everything a breeze. I used a makeup brush shampoo from Sephora in the water and replaced with fresh every few brushes.  A few reviews have mentioned it doesn’t work as well for larger brushes but I didn’t find that to be the case. Depending on the contour of the handle it may flop a bit and spin funny, but I found it was simp

This electric brush cleaner makes it easy to clean my brushes. It does the work for me and I feel like it does a better job than clean it by hand. Cleaning your makeup brushes is so important but I didn't do it as I should have.  I don't have to get my hands covered in wet pigment and it's really inexpensive! Absolutely worth the price!!!!

reviews.t: You get what you pay for
reviews.x: The idea is great and the product could deliver. If you want to clean your brushes more often and decrease drying time then a tool like this will work for that. However, this particular product is trash because the the pin that attaches to the motor continuously disconnects which exponentially increases the time for washing and drying your brushes. Also, i would use something like this for the everyday makeup brushes and not the nice expensive ones. I would still clean my traditional brushes the

I''ve been looking for a method for a long time to clean my brush quickly and easily :( The device is great and has helped me a lot, now every week I can clean my brush quickly and easily !!! The packaging top !!! Beautiful brush in a very noble " container" . They are so beautiful that they are too good to use I will recommend this brand in any case and certainly stay with this brand. My most important criterion for why I ordered there is that this brand only sells vegan products. No animal had

reviews.t: This does not work for me.
reviews.x: This brush cleaner did not work for me and I followed the directions precisely.  The brushes did not come out clean (or dry).  It doesn't have enough power to spin the larger foundation brushes while it was down in the cleaner and didn't spin them out dry either.  Perhaps I got a bad unit or it just doesn't work like the other reviews indicated.  I ended up hand washing all of my brushes like usual and placing them on my deck railing to dry.  It is a novel idea just which it would have worked fo

I bought this product to clean my many eye shadow brushes and blusher/bronzer brushes. I particularly like that I don''t need to use a specific solution with the kit (N.B. a solution is recommended for foundation brushes, but I don''t use these). The instructions are easy to follow, and it really cleans and dries your brushes. My only improvement would address how to clean double ended brushes; otherwise I would have given it 5*. I would and have recommended this to my fellow make up lovers!

reviews.t: All makeup brushes will not fit the barrels and doesn’t completely clean brushes.
reviews.x: What I like about this product is it’s compact size. Where there could be some improvements is the makeup brush barrel/holder. A lot of my brushes didn’t fit secure and the one that did, it didn’t get that clean after changing the water a couple of times. I haven’t used it since. All and all with a few adjustments, this could be a great product. I don’t remember if I received this product at a discounted price, however this is my honest opinion.

I don't get why this is better than washing your brushes by hand. When i wash them by hand, they are definitely cleaner. And i could understand sacrificing that for practicality but... this takes longer. Getting the brushes in and out of the very sticky tubes is hard and time consuming. My brushes were not cleaned properly, none of them turned back to their original color completely. So it's harder, messier and takes longer. I don't get it.

reviews.t: Quick clean but not all brushes fit..
reviews.x: The setup is easy to use. I love that it cleans quickly. However, the reason for my 3 stars is because i wish it had a few more smaller sizes for my eye makeuo brushes. I dont have many big bulky brushes so some of those sizes ill barely use. And so because some are too big or too small my brushes either it stuck or would almost slip out. So thats my only critic. Otherwise it does a wonderful job at cleaning and drying them.

I bought this because me and my mom have so many brushes, so it took forever to clean them. I was hesitant to try this but the video and price convinced me. I’m very happy with this product. It’s very easy to put together, very versatile with different brush sizes, and cleans & dries very fast. I was very surprised at the results of how clean and dry the brushes were after using it. Great price and easy to use.

This did not clean my makeup brushes at all. It barely took off any makeup even the one that were slightly used. The only good thing I would say is that it did a great job drying the brushes after I hand washed all them. If anything you can at least use it as a brush dryer, which is the only reason I am giving it 2 stars.

It didn't do the job like expected. I guess for the price of the product it did the job of spinning but not cleaning. If you really want something to clean your brushes good , go buy a brush washing glove or scrubbing mat to help you clean your brushes. This product didn't work for me, but a scrubbing mat did.

I just washed and dried all my brushes and I could not be happier!! So glad I didn’t spend $40 on the one I saw on Instagram. This one totally did the trick. It’s a little hard to find the right size holder for the brush. You definitely have to force it in some to make it fit. Overall tho it’s great!

reviews.t: Pretty good product and easy to use.
reviews.x: I bought for my daughter and she loves it! Reason i’m giving it 4 stars is because originally it was missing a part, so she couldn’t use it. They were really good about sending us a replacement, with all the parts this time. It was east to set up. And she uses it all the time for all her brushes!

Cleaning make up brushes is so easy with this. I like that the bowl is plastic because I have cats who are absurd and will knock things down just because they can so I appreciate the plastic. Very easy to use. I cleaned 15 brushes in just a few minutes.

reviews.t: Worth it for the low dollar cost.
reviews.x: This works great for small to medium makeup brushes, but the little motor isn’t strong enough to support larger/heavier (large finishing powder/blush) brushes. I’m still glad I bought it as it’s cut my brush-washing time down by 75%.

This product is okay it does clean your little brushes and dries them fairly quickly however it looses all its strength while washing bigger brushes such a bummer, however i would never recommend this product to anyone.

It doesn't take away all the product left from the brushes. It only takes away like 50% off of it which is literally useless to me.. Everything worked perfectly fine, I just wish it worked the way it claims it does
I wish it was more sturdy and more powerful. If you push the brush too far into the bowl, the motor will stop spinning, but if you don’t do that then you won’t get all of the makeup off the brush.
I thought this would be cool but my brushes are still dirty at the base of the bristles. Also, my bushes really don't fit the rubber holders so they kind fall off once the cleaner is in use.

claims.text: Many reviewers say it cleans and dries brushes quickly and easily, saving time compared to hand washing.
A common complaint is that not all brushes fit securely in the silicone sleeves or holders, with some falling out or being too big or too small.
Several reviewers report the attachment pin or part connecting to the wand/motor keeps falling off or disconnecting, disrupting cleaning.
Some users find it lacks power for larger or heavier brushes, which spin slowly or don't get fully clean or dry.
Some reviewers feel it doesn't clean as well as hand washing or isn't worth it compared to manual cleaning.
